title: Notifications
privacy: Company administrators manage channels. Secrets stay in the existing vault; saving never sends a message.
loadError: Unable to load notifications. Check company permissions.
operationError: Operation failed. Check configuration and permissions, then retry.
workerOff: Delivery worker disabled by deployment configuration
notLive: Protocol implementation is not proof of delivery to your real tenant. Accepted does not mean read.
name: Channel name
saveHelp: New channels are paused. Enable explicitly and subscribe only to connected events.
testText: This is an explicitly requested test notification.
testWarning: This sends a real external message. Check the channel target and content. Retry an uncertain delivery only after reconciliation.
subscriptionHelp: Enabled subscriptions send future event summaries to this channel. Pausing does not recall messages; re-enabling may release queued deliveries.
retryWarning: Check the external platform first. Retrying keeps the original unknown record and may send the same message again, using its original credential version.
reviewedOutcome: I checked the external delivery outcome
acceptDuplicateRisk: I accept the risk of a duplicate message
